Local Brazilian Portuguese spelling runtime.

Hunspell engine: https://github.com/hunspell/hunspell (LGPL/GPL/MPL alternatives).

VERO Brazilian Portuguese dictionary, unmodified index.aff/index.dic.
Distributed under the MPL alternative; original dictionary notice preserved.
Worker source: scripts/comment_spelling_worker.js; build: scripts/build_comment_spelling.cjs.
No remote spelling service or runtime CDN is used.
